title: TrakHound Package Publish Targets
description: Where Packages are published (trakhound.package.publish.json), as named Publish Targets. The CLI uses the nearest file, in the Package folder or a parent folder. See the Developer Guide, section 8.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file (for editors). Ignored by the CLI.

defaultTarget.description: The Target used when --target isn't set (ex. "development").

targets.description: The Publish Targets, by name (ex. "development" and "release").

destinations.description: The Package Servers and Organizations to upload to.

versionSuffix.description: A prerelease label added to every version published to this Target. {timestamp} is the UTC time of the run, {branch} is empty on main and -[branch] on other branches (ex. "dev{branch}.{timestamp}" builds 0.3.4-dev.20261114153000). No suffix publishes stable versions.

allowDirty.description: Build uncommitted changes. Needs {timestamp} in versionSuffix, so each build has its own version.

requireSigning.description: Packages must be signed (and the working tree clean) to be published to this Target.

packageServer.description: The URL of the Package Server (ex. https://packages.contoso.com).

organization.description: The Organization to publish the Package to.

apiTokenVariable.description: The environment variable that holds the Api Token for this Package Server (ex. CONTOSO_RELEASE_TOKEN). Without it, the CLI's Api Token is used.
